knowledge:
- key_parameters: weights=adjusts the relative weight/influence of each modality in rescaleByNeighbors() ;; n_components=controls the number of dimensions to avoid loss of information in calculateMultiUMAP() ;; extras=specifies additional modality matrices (e.g., ADT PCs) to integrate with the main modality in runMultiUMAP() ;; block=specifies blocking factors to control for batch effects in computeCorrelations() and findTopCorrelations() ;; number=specifies the number of top positive/negative correlated features to extract in findTopCorrelations() ;; d=controls the number of PCs used for data compression to modify approximation quality in findTopCorrelations()
- alternatives: Naive cluster concatenation (e.g., paste0(adt.clusters, ".", rna.clusters)) which creates too many small, irrelevant clusters, whereas intersectClusters() merges them ;; Exact correlation search via computeCorrelations() which is very slow for large datasets, whereas findTopCorrelations() performs an approximate search for the top most-correlated features
- when_to_use: Use when analyzing single-cell datasets with multiple modalities (e.g., CITE-seq, single-cell RNA-seq + ADT, or RNA-seq + ATAC-seq) collected from the same cells, and you want to perform integrated clustering, dimensionality reduction, or feature-to-feature correlation analyses.
- pitfalls: Combining modalities without rescaling can cause the modality with more features or stronger technical variation to dominate downstream calculations ;; Naive cluster intersection creates a large number of small, irrelevant clusters ;; Exact correlation analysis (computeCorrelations()) is extremely slow on large feature sets and should be restricted to small subsets or replaced with findTopCorrelations().

workflows.name: multimodal_integration_and_clustering
workflows.intent: Integrate multiple single-cell modalities (e.g., RNA and ADT) for downstream clustering and dimensionality reduction using neighbor-based rescaling, cluster intersection, multi-metric UMAP, or graph intersection.
input: sce2 (SingleCellExperiment object containing RNA-seq data and an alternative experiment with ADT/protein data, both preprocessed with PCA)
workflows.stages: 1. Rescale modality matrices by neighbor distance using rescaleByNeighbors() ;; 2. Perform clustering on the combined rescaled matrix ;; 3. Intersect independent clusterings using intersectClusters() ;; 4. Compute multi-metric UMAP using calculateMultiUMAP() or runMultiUMAP() ;; 5. Intersect nearest-neighbor graphs using intersectGraphs()
workflows.code:
output <- rescaleByNeighbors(list(reducedDim(sce2), reducedDim(altExp(sce2))))
dim(output)
set.seed(100001)
library(bluster)
sce2$combined.clustering <- clusterRows(output, NNGraphParam())
reducedDim(sce2, "combined") <- output
sce2 <- runTSNE(sce2, dimred="combined")
plotTSNE(sce2, colour_by="combined.clustering")
g.rna <- buildSNNGraph(sce2, use.dimred="PCA")
rna.clusters <- igraph::cluster_walktrap(g.rna)$membership
table(rna.clusters)
g.adt <- buildSNNGraph(altExp(sce2), use.dimred='PCA')
adt.clusters <- igraph::cluster_walktrap(g.adt)$membership
table(adt.clusters)
intersected2 <- intersectClusters(list(rna.clusters, adt.clusters), list(reducedDim(sce2), reducedDim(altExp(sce2))))
table(intersected2)
set.seed(100002)
umap.out <- calculateMultiUMAP(list(reducedDim(sce2), reducedDim(altExp(sce2))), n_components=20)
dim(umap.out)
library(bluster)
sce2$umap.clustering <- clusterRows(umap.out, NNGraphParam())
set.seed(100002)
sce2 <- runMultiUMAP(sce2, dimred="PCA", extras=list(reducedDim(altExp(sce2))))
plotReducedDim(sce2, "MultiUMAP", colour_by="umap.clustering")
g.com <- intersectGraphs(g.rna, g.adt)
com.clusters <- igraph::cluster_walktrap(g.com)$membership
table(com.clusters)

workflows.name: feature_correlation_analysis
workflows.intent: Identify and analyze correlations between features of different modalities (e.g., RNA genes and ADT proteins), optionally accounting for batch effects.
input: sce2 (SingleCellExperiment object containing RNA-seq data and an alternative experiment with ADT/protein data)
workflows.stages: 1. Compute exact pairwise correlations between features of different modalities using computeCorrelations() ;; 2. Compute exact pairwise correlations with blocking factors using computeCorrelations(..., block=b) ;; 3. Perform approximate search for top correlated features using findTopCorrelations()
workflows.code:
cor.all <- computeCorrelations(sce2, altExp(sce2)[1:5,])
cor.all[order(cor.all$p.value),]
b <- rep(1:3, length.out=ncol(sce2))
cor.all.batch <- computeCorrelations(sce2, altExp(sce2)[1:5,], block=b)
set.seed(100001) # for IRLBA.
top.cor <- findTopCorrelations(sce2[1:100,], y=altExp(sce2), number=10)
top.cor
top.cor$positive
